name: Refinex
author: WP Plugify

sections.description:
Refinex is a lightweight and easy-to-use WordPress plugin that improves how visitors search and browse your website. It allows users to quickly search and filter posts by categories, making content easier to find and improving the overall user experience. Instead of scrolling through long pages or using basic search, your visitors can narrow down results in seconds with a clean and intuitive interface.
The plugin is designed to be fast, simple, and flexible, so it works well for blogs, news sites, portfolios, and content-rich websites. It integrates smoothly with your existing WordPress setup and helps keep visitors engaged by showing them exactly what they’re looking for—without confusion or extra clicks. If you want to make your site easier to explore and more user-friendly, REFINEX is a perfect solution.

Features and Options

  • Search Taxonomies, Tags, Categories.
  • Generate Shortcode.
  • Easy Setup.
  • Use for blogs, agency sites, news sites, property sites and more.
  • Place anywhere in your themes and posts using shortcodes.
  • Extremely easy to use admin UI, fully integrated with WP 3.8+

Support

Get free dedicated support from our developers.
sections.installation:
1. Login to your WordPress Admin Area

    1. Go to Plugins > Add New
    2. Type “Refinex” into the Search and hit Enter.
    3. Find this plugin Click “Install now”
    4. Activate The Plugin
    5. Use Refinex on any themes that allow users to review and reaction.

    Manual Installation

    1. Download the plugin from WordPress.org repository
    2. On your WordPress admin dashboard, go to ‘Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin’
    3. Upload the downloaded plugin file (refinex.zip) and click ‘Install Now’
    4. Activate ‘Refinex’ from your Plugins page.
    5. Use Refinex on any themes that allow users to review and reaction.
sections.faq:
Can I use Refinex with any WordPress theme?

  • Yes, It can be used with any WordPress theme.

What is the plugin license?

  • This plugin is released under the GPL license.
